title: SR Beauty
summary: A fully custom Shopify storefront built from scratch to support a catalogue of 4,000+ products, a dual B2B and B2C shopping experience, and complex business-specific functionality.
overview: SR Beauty was a complex e-commerce project that required much more than a standard Shopify theme. I built the store from scratch, developing a custom storefront around a catalogue of more than 4,000 products while accommodating the distinct needs of both business customers and individual consumers. The project combined custom theme development, tailored functionality, and a scalable structure designed to support a demanding retail operation.
challenge: The main challenge was bringing a large product catalogue, B2B and B2C purchasing requirements, and multiple custom functionalities together in one cohesive storefront. The system needed to handle the complexity of a substantial catalogue while providing a clear, reliable, and responsive shopping experience for different customer types.
solution: I developed a custom Shopify theme from the ground up and built the storefront architecture around the project's specific business requirements. I implemented tailored functionality for the B2B and B2C shopping experience, structured the interface to accommodate more than 4,000 products, and customized page templates and reusable components to create a consistent experience throughout the store.
deliverables: Complete Shopify store development from scratch
Custom product and collection page templates
results: Successfully launched a fully custom Shopify storefront built from scratch
Structured a catalogue of 4,000+ products within a scalable store architecture
Unified B2B and B2C shopping experiences within one e-commerce platform
Delivered custom functionality tailored to the business's operational requirements
Established a consistent, responsive shopping experience across the storefront
Created a flexible custom theme designed for ongoing maintenance and future growth

title: Susanna Falken
summary: A comprehensive Shopify audit and optimization project focused on improving storefront speed, fixing cart issues, and optimizing the shopping journey with conversion-focused features.
overview: Susanna Falken needed more than visual improvements. I audited the existing Shopify storefront to identify performance bottlenecks, cart issues, and friction points that could interrupt the path to purchase. I then implemented targeted technical fixes and conversion-focused enhancements to make the shopping experience faster, smoother, and better equipped to encourage additional purchases.
challenge: Store speed issues and cart-related problems were creating friction in the buying journey and potentially costing sales. The product pages also had opportunities to improve purchase accessibility and product discovery through more effective Add to Cart placement, upselling, and cross-selling.
solution: I audited the storefront and addressed performance issues and cart functionality problems affecting the customer journey. I implemented a sticky Add to Cart experience to keep the primary purchase action accessible, refined upsell and cross-sell opportunities to encourage complementary purchases, and resolved additional storefront issues identified during the audit. The work focused on reducing friction and making the store more reliable and conversion-friendly.
results: Identified and addressed storefront issues affecting the shopping experience
Improved store speed through targeted performance optimizations
Resolved cart-related issues that could disrupt purchases
Made the Add to Cart action more accessible with a sticky implementation
Added upsell and cross-sell opportunities to support complementary purchases
Created a smoother, more reliable path from product discovery to checkout

title: VAPEGALA
summary: A complete e-commerce storefront redesign focused on creating a cohesive shopping experience, improving page layouts, and establishing a consistent visual identity across the entire store.
overview: VapeGala needed a refreshed storefront that delivered a more consistent and intuitive shopping experience. I redesigned the entire store, reworking every page to create a unified visual language, improve content hierarchy, and make product discovery and navigation feel more seamless.
challenge: The main challenge was to redesign the complete storefront rather than focusing on individual pages. Every page needed to feel connected, remain easy to navigate, and support a consistent shopping experience across desktop and mobile devices.
solution: I carried out a full storefront redesign, updating page layouts, visual styling, content structure, and responsive behavior throughout the store. The redesign brought greater consistency to the customer journey while creating a cleaner, more cohesive interface across the entire shopping experience.
results: Delivered a complete redesign of the entire Shopify storefront
Established a consistent visual identity across all website pages
Improved page layouts and content hierarchy throughout the store
Created a more cohesive product browsing and shopping experience
Implemented responsive layouts for desktop and mobile devices
Customized the Shopify theme to align with the refreshed storefront design

title: Patrice Fransez
summary: Targeted Shopify storefront improvements focused on refining the shopping experience, addressing usability issues, and making key customer interactions smoother.
overview: For Patrice Fransez, I worked on targeted improvements to the existing Shopify storefront, focusing on refining the user experience and addressing areas where small changes could make the shopping journey smoother. The work involved practical theme adjustments tailored to the store's needs.
challenge: The goal was to improve the existing storefront without undertaking a full redesign, focusing on specific areas where usability and the overall shopping experience could be refined.
solution: I made focused adjustments to the Shopify theme to improve the storefront experience and refine key interface elements. Rather than rebuilding existing functionality, I concentrated on practical improvements that fit the current design and business requirements.
results: Refined the existing storefront without requiring a complete redesign
Addressed selected usability and shopping experience improvements
Delivered focused theme customizations aligned with the brand
Improved key interface details while retaining the existing storefront structure

title: Risen
summary: Product data integration and troubleshooting to address missing product visibility in Google Search Console caused by market-related configuration issues.
overview: Risen Fragrances had product data that was not appearing as expected in Google Search Console due to market-related configuration issues. I investigated the problem and worked on integrating the product data correctly so the storefront could provide the relevant information for search engine discovery.
challenge: Market-related configuration issues were affecting product data visibility in Google Search Console. The challenge was to identify the source of the problem and ensure product information was correctly exposed for search engine processing.
solution: I investigated the product data visibility issue, addressed the relevant market-related configuration, and integrated the product data to improve consistency and availability for search engine discovery. I focused on ensuring the storefront exposed the appropriate product information for Google's crawling and indexing processes.
deliverables: Investigation of missing product data in Google Search Console
results: Addressed product data visibility issues associated with market configuration
Improved the availability and consistency of product information for search engine processing
Resolved technical issues affecting product data discovery
Established a more reliable product data setup for ongoing search visibility
